title: Typography editorial
intendedUserGoal: Read and understand long-form review guidance without strain.

strongFindings.rootCause: Long line length and tight line height reduce reading comfort.
Heading and body hierarchy does not create enough editorial rhythm.

rootCauseObservations: Readability is the root concern; avoid generic typography labels without impact.
mergeGuidance: Merge line length and line height into one readability finding when they affect the same paragraph.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Do not create separate findings for every text block.
